card.name: Inside capitalized boxed-warning terms
card.fires_on: Pieces partway through long medical words written in ALL CAPS, mostly in boxed warning headings. Examples are the H of HEPATIC, the ID of EPIDURAL and the RO of GASTROINTESTINAL.

modes.label: Split warning terms
modes.description: The start or middle of an all-caps medical term such as hepatic, epidural or gastrointestinal.

modes.label: Caps linking word
modes.description: A small linking word like AND inside an all-caps warning title.
modes.example: EXACERBATION OF HEPATITIS B and RISK OF DRUG RESISTANCE WITH USE OF EMTRICITABINE<< AND>> TENOFOVIR DISOPRO

card.writes: The promoted tokens are he/his/him words, which do not fit the text, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires inside long medical words in all-caps warning headings, such as hepatic or epidural.
